summary: Frontend-only testing of the expanded Dining/Restaurant section for Hotel Terme Leonardo (IT/DE/FR/EN). Verified rendering, correct DOM position (between rooms-gallery-section and dayspa), board options (Bed & Breakfast + Half Board), 5 meal-time rows, Bistrot La Piazza highlighted card, full-board disclaimer, and language reactivity within the same session (no reload) across IT, EN, DE, FR. All 20 assertions passed. No runtime errors in console.
critical_code_review_comments: Dining.jsx uses f.name as React key inside formulas.map — fine while names are unique per locale, but consider using stable index if names could collide.
Same for hours.map using h.t as key — currently unique but fragile if translations ever repeat a label.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dining section fully verified across all 4 languages. Selector data-testid='dining-section' works; language switches via data-testid='lang-{it|en|de|fr}' are reactive without reload. Section order in DOM: benessere → golf → camere → rooms-gallery-section → ristorante → dayspa → cure → ...
